name: Career Match
author: careerchangefinder.com (our own questions)
note: Our own questions. Each answer is compared with O*NET Work Context data for every career. Not a validated psychological test.
instructions: Tell us what kind of workday you want. There are no right or wrong answers. Pick "Doesn't matter" if you have no preference.

scoring.method: For each answered question, fit = 1 - |target - career percentile|. Career Match = weighted mean of fits, 0-100. "Doesn't matter" has weight 0.
scoring.education: Question 12 is a filter: careers that usually need more preparation than you chose are hidden from the top results, not scored lower.
scoring.combined: Free Career Test ranking = 60% interest fit (Interest Profiler correlation, negative values set to 0) + 40% Career Match. Shown separately from the official Interest Profiler results.
